title: test(imap): unit tests for ENABLE IMAP4rev2 handler
description:
Write unit tests for the ENABLE IMAP4rev2 handler. Tests must be independent of the implementation — expected behavior is derived from RFC 5161 (ENABLE) and RFC 9051 §6.3.2.

Tests to write (in a new #[cfg(test)] block in session/mod.rs or a new session/tests.rs):
1. enable_imap4rev2_sets_latch: construct a SessionContext with imap4rev2_enabled=false in Authenticated state; simulate ENABLE IMAP4rev2 command; assert imap4rev2_enabled is true afterwards; assert * ENABLED response contains IMAP4rev2.
2. enable_imap4rev2_is_idempotent: set imap4rev2_enabled=true; simulate ENABLE IMAP4rev2 again; assert * ENABLED response contains empty capability list (RFC 5161 §3: must not re-list already-enabled caps); assert imap4rev2_enabled is still true.
3. enable_in_not_authenticated_state_returns_no: construct SessionContext in NotAuthenticated state; simulate ENABLE IMAP4rev2; assert tagged NO response; assert imap4rev2_enabled remains false.
4. enable_unknown_capability_ignored: simulate ENABLE UNKNOWNCAP; assert * ENABLED is empty; assert no error; assert imap4rev2_enabled remains false.

Oracle: RFC 5161 §3 and RFC 9051 §6.3.2 define the expected wire behavior.

Acceptance: cargo test -p stoa-imap passes with all 4 tests green.
